srep-0038-model-material-override.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<scene version="1.2">
<project width="640" height="360" fps="24" duration="1" background="#000000FF"/>
<output id="still" path="out/frame_%04d.png" codec="png-sequence"/>
<assets><mesh id="mesh-marker" src="../assets/materials.glb" format="glb"/></assets>
<materials><material id="m-red" baseColor="#FF0000FF" unlit="true" doubleSided="true"/><material id="m-green" baseColor="#00FF00FF" unlit="true" doubleSided="true"/><material id="m-blue" baseColor="#0000FFFF" unlit="true" doubleSided="true"/><material id="m-yellow" baseColor="#FFFF00FF" unlit="true" doubleSided="true"/></materials>
<composition>
<object3D id="m" primitive="mesh" mesh="mesh-marker" materialOverride="stone:m-blue" x="320" y="200" z="0"/>
</composition>
</scene>

expected.rule: SREP 38 (Semantics: each primitive whose imported material has that name is drawn with the document material; a material with no pair keeps its imported look). materials.glb has two primitives, `stone` (red) at x = -0.4 m and `old` (green) at +0.4 m; with materialOverride="stone:m-blue" the left primitive is blue and the right stays green. A model point (gx, gy) is at (320 + 100 gx, 200 - 100 gy): the triangles span 20 x 30 px about (280, 200) and (360, 200) (their vertex average y is 0).

srep-0038-model-material-precedence.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<scene version="1.2">
<project width="640" height="360" fps="24" duration="1" background="#000000FF"/>
<output id="still" path="out/frame_%04d.png" codec="png-sequence"/>
<assets><mesh id="mesh-marker" src="../assets/materials.glb" format="glb"/></assets>
<materials><material id="m-red" baseColor="#FF0000FF" unlit="true" doubleSided="true"/><material id="m-green" baseColor="#00FF00FF" unlit="true" doubleSided="true"/><material id="m-blue" baseColor="#0000FFFF" unlit="true" doubleSided="true"/><material id="m-yellow" baseColor="#FFFF00FF" unlit="true" doubleSided="true"/></materials>
<composition>
<object3D id="m" primitive="mesh" mesh="mesh-marker" material="m-yellow" materialOverride="stone:m-blue" x="320" y="200" z="0"/>
</composition>
</scene>

expected.rule: SREP 38 (Semantics: @material replaces every material and takes precedence over materialOverride): both primitives are yellow, one 100 x 30 px blob about (320, 200) (the two triangles span x 270 to 370).
